title: Separable field extensions have no Kähler differentials
statement: If F/k is a finite separable extension of fields, then \Omega_{F/k}=0 (equivalently, the universal k-derivation F\to\Omega_{F/k} is zero), with \Omega as in [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials].
